@app.route('/deleteImage')
def deleteImage():
    '''
    Get file name from request, 
    validate the request, and delete the image file
    '''
    # Get the file name from the request
    file_name = request.args.get('filename')
    
    # Validate the file name to prevent path traversal
    if not is_valid_file(file_name):
        return "Invalid filename", 400
    
    # Construct the full path of the file to be deleted
    file_path = os.path.join('/safe/directory/', file_name)
    
    # Check if the file exists and is within the allowed directory
    if not os.path.exists(file_path):
        return "File does not exist", 404
    
    # Delete the file safely
    os.remove(file_path)
    
    return "File deleted successfully", 200
